# Grants

## Requirements

- Awards above 50,000 must be countersigned by the programme director, under Grants Policy 8.

## Stories

- As a programme director, I want to countersign any award above 50,000 before it is released so that large grants get a second pair of eyes.
- As an assessor, I want to score applications against the criteria so that decisions are consistent.
- As an applicant, I want to track my application so that I know when to expect a decision.
